datasets.name: HR-GLDD dataset
datasets.verbatim: The HR-GLDD dataset [23] is used to test the performance of the landslide detection methods.

methods.name: FedLD (Federated learning-based landslide detection)
methods.summary: FedLD is a federated learning framework for landslide detection that uses horizontal federated learning (HFL) to train models across decentralized clients without sharing raw data. It incorporates a novel marginal contribution (MC) metric to measure client contributions and a weighted model aggregation algorithm (MCA) to aggregate local models into a global model based on data quality.
methods.verbatim: To bridge this gap, this letter proposes a privacy-preserving machine learning method named federated learning-based landslide detection (FedLD) for landslide detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory dataset is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the FedLD method is not provided or linked.
